  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the configured benefits for each loyalty tier in the merchant's programme.
Use this to display the perks a customer currently enjoys at their tier, and what
benefits await them upon upgrading — an effective driver of tier aspiration. The
response is a list of tier benefit objects, one per configured tier, reflecting the
merchant's live programme settings. This endpoint does not require a customer
identifier if you want the full programme-level tier list.
